plotSections.title: Walker’s finances
bullets: Walker has only about fourteen hundred gold on hand—826 gold and 61 platinum—while roughly ten thousand gold remains back in Langdale.
That is barely enough for one potion from Quaylin and leaves him nearly broke.

plotSections.title: Meeting Hanzuni at Haven Hold
bullets: Walker enters Haven Hold’s hoard hall and calls out to Hanzuni, an ancient copper dragon swimming through his treasure.
Hanzuni greets Glimmen first, remembers her as a hatchling, and has forgotten Walker’s name.
Glimmen dives into the hoard to swim with him; Hanzuni is only slightly larger than her despite his ancient age.

plotSections.title: Quaylin’s backstory
bullets: Hanzuni confirms Quaylin of Quaylin’s Quax and says Quaylin has won two Sunder Chases.
Quaylin was not always a duck-fowl; a magical beak heirloom transmutes the wearer and grants great potion knowledge.
The neck heirloom is his second-win prize; the beak relates to his first.
Quaylin arrived in Sunder after his race with only potion craft on his small vessel.

plotSections.title: Exhaustion and Hanzuni’s scrutiny
bullets: Walker asks Hanzuni for something to remedy terrible daily exhaustion despite constant training.
Hanzuni sees shimmering magical energy on Walker and criticizes his mismatched star sapphire and star ruby earrings.
He offers an even trade from the hoard for matching gems; Walker declines to keep the story of how he earned them from a past dragon hoard fight.
Hanzuni says many hoard items could cure exhaustion, but removing magical items from the hoard requires triggering a Sunder Chase by throwing a gauntlet into the treasure.

plotSections.title: The gold hand revealed
bullets: Walker cannot remove his golden hand to throw it into the hoard.
When Hanzuni grabs it, the gold slides off as a perfect golden replica, revealing Walker’s normal flesh hand beneath.
It is not a gauntlet but pure gold; Hanzuni calls it cure gold and returns it, and Walker can put it back on.
Walker asks what the gold hand is worth; Hanzuni asks how much it weighs, and Walker estimates about four hundred grams.

chronologicalEvents: Walker notes most of his wealth is in Langdale and only about fourteen hundred gold is on his person.
Walker calls out to Hanzuni at Haven Hold; Glimmen swims in the hoard with the dragon.
Hanzuni remembers Glimmen as a hatchling and Walker reintroduces himself.
Walker asks after Quaylin; Hanzuni recounts Quaylin’s Sunder Chase wins and magical beak history.
Walker requests a remedy for worsening daily exhaustion.
Hanzuni detects magical energy on Walker and mocks his mismatched star gem earrings.
Hanzuni offers a hoard trade for matching gems; Walker refuses.
Hanzuni explains hoard magical items require a Sunder Chase to remove and suggests throwing a gauntlet.
Walker tries and fails to remove his golden hand; Hanzuni pulls off a solid gold replica of the hand instead.
Hanzuni returns the gold hand; Walker asks its value and estimates its weight at four hundred grams.

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider bonded to Glimmen, Gatekeeper of The Reach.
notes: Has about 826 gold and 61 platinum on hand while roughly ten thousand gold sits in Langdale.
Suffers terrible exhaustion every day despite constant training.
Carries star sapphire and star ruby earrings from a past dragon hoard fight.
His golden hand is not a gauntlet but a removable solid gold replica of his hand.
Cannot throw the gold hand into the hoard to trigger a Sunder Chase.
Estimates the detached gold hand weighs about four hundred grams.
openQuestions: What would you say this gold hand is worth?

Hanzuni.existing: Ancient copper dragon whose hoard sits at the center of Haven Hold.
notes: One of two ancient copper dragons Walker has met on The Reach; name spelled H-A-Z-U-N-I.
Relatively small for an ancient dragon, with polished copper scales from swimming in his hoard.
Less tarnished than Araden due to constant activity in treasure.
Greets Glimmen before Walker and has forgotten Walker’s name.
Perceives shimmering magical energy on Walker and criticizes his mismatched earrings.
Says magical hoard items that could cure exhaustion require a Sunder Chase to remove.
Can physically remove Walker’s gold hand, identifying it as cure gold rather than a gauntlet.
Has grown bored waiting for another Sunder Chase since Walker’s last race.
personality: Playful, fashion-conscious, and eager for Sunder Chase excitement.
quotesThemes: Have you come for a swim, my dear?
All you need to do is take that golden gauntlet off your hand and throw it into the hoard.

notes: Dives eagerly into Hanzuni’s hoard when invited to swim.
Hanzuni remembers her as a hatchling and notes she is now fully grown with a rider.
Is roughly similar in size to Hanzuni.
personality: Excited and antsy when offered a swim in treasure.

Quaylin.existing: Duck Aarakocra shopkeeper of Quaylin’s Quax in Sunder.
notes: Known to Hanzuni; winner of two Sunder Chases.
Was not always a duck-fowl; magical beak heirloom transmutes wearer and grants potion knowledge.
Neck heirloom is prize of second win; beak relates to first win.
Arrived in Sunder after his race with only potion craft aboard his vessel.

Haven Hold.existing: Sunder district containing a dragon hoard.
notes: Hoard hall is a lively arched market with treasure on a central floating island separated by an empty moat.
Throwing a gauntlet into the hoard triggers a Sunder Chase.
Hoard magic prevents treasure from falling away and replenishes spilled coins.
Magical items taken from the hoard require completing a Sunder Chase.
Throwing a gauntlet into Hanzuni’s hoard triggers a chase to claim treasure.
Removing magical items from the hoard, including exhaustion remedies, requires participating in a chase.

Araden.existing: A magically capable companion brought secretly to The Reach.
notes: Hanzuni’s scales are less tarnished than Araden’s, apparently from greater activity and contact with treasure.

notes: Hanzuni’s term for the solid gold material of Walker’s hand; not a gauntlet and removable as a golden replica.

notes: Magical beak heirloom that transmutes the wearer into a duck-fowl and grants great potion knowledge; Quaylin’s first Sunder Chase prize.
